description: Fetch a profile of a Polish public procuring entity (zamawiający) by its NIP (tax ID). Returns name, location, statistics, recent tenders, and top winning contractors. Use for due diligence on who buys what and from whom.

include_winning_contractors.description: If true, also fetch the list of contractors that most frequently win this buyer's tenders. Default: true.

nip.description: Polish tax ID (NIP) of the procuring entity — 10 digits

name: get_buyer
title: Get profile of a procuring entity (zamawiający)
